results.summary_before: The RGB Mixer demo takes inputs from three digital encoders, debounces them, and produces three PWM outputs whose duty cycles correspond to the encoder values. It is intended to be tested by twisting each encoder and observing the brightness of LEDs connected to the PWM outputs. The design requires three external digital encoders and was reported working by the author, who checked all three channels.

results.summary_before: This design is an error-correcting FIFO buffer that uses SECDED error correction and ARQ retransmission to provide reliable data transmission. It buffers 4-bit data and supports normal, corrupted, and retransmission modes through error mode selection, generating ACK and NACK signals for handshaking. The design is verified using Cocotb testbenches that cover normal transmission, error injection, retransmission, and sequential reads. It runs at a very low clock of 10 Hz and is notable for integrating lightweight error correction into a small FIFO buffer.
